name: Linkjob AI
tagline: Real-time AI interview assistant for live job and coding interviews
description: Linkjob AI is an interview assistant that runs beside your video call. While the interviewer is speaking it transcribes the question and drafts an answer on screen, based on your resume and the job description you uploaded, so you can structure your reply instead of freezing. It covers behavioral questions, technical and coding rounds and online assessments, and works with Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams in several languages. There is also a mock-interview mode for practice before the real thing.
